# Data Detox

Data Detox provides project-based database reactivation for individual real
estate salespeople throughout New Zealand. Donna personally calls neglected
contacts, updates CRM information and hands genuine opportunities back to the
salesperson. The site is public and may be crawled to understand its services
and business information.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://datadetox.co.nz/): Overview of Data Detox and its services.
- [About](https://datadetox.co.nz/about/): Background and experience.
- [Database Reactivation](https://datadetox.co.nz/database-revitalisation/): Calling neglected real estate contacts and updating records as the project progresses.
- [Past Client Reconnection](https://datadetox.co.nz/client-verification/): Personal calls to reconnect with past clients and identify follow-up.
- [Appraisal Follow-Up](https://datadetox.co.nz/appraisal-preparation/): Following up older appraisals and handing interested contacts back to the salesperson.
